stage: 1 of 3: joint table and document inference
owner: owner review of S93 and consolidated instruction, verbatim in .claude/skills/pee-guided-learning/references/owner-review-s93-2026-10-20.md
writtenBefore: any Stage 1 arm is scored; the relation code was probed only for coverage counts on the S93 raw pages (tables fitted, rows typed), never against a reference
question: Does whole-table inference (one hypothesis per column, verified by arithmetic; statistic rows; row subjects) recover the calculated values, their inputs and the exact product of each row that S93's sentence-level rules missed, without new false calculations?
references: Limaye, Sarawagi, Chakrabarti 2010 (collective annotation of tables)
Zhang 2017 TableMiner+ (iterative whole-table inference with context)
Zhang et al. 2020 Sato (column types in the context of the table)
Wang et al. 2021 TUTA (tree-based cell dependencies)

mechanism.relative_difference: a percentage column explained, row by row, by ONE formula and ONE reference value v0; each row's printed precision bounds v0 (interval stabbing); at least 3 rows and 60% of the column; the best formula must beat the others. Inputs: the row's own value cell and the reference row. No words
mechanism.statistic_over_set: a row whose label begins with a statistic (average, mean, median, minimum, maximum, range, total) or states n=: its values are calculated over a set
mechanism.row_subject: the row label against the document's principal product: every principal name token present = reviewed product; statistic label = set; another proper name = other product
mechanism.comparative_prose: (arm T1c only) a percentage in a comparative construction (higher/lower/... than, relative to, compared with, delta) is a relative difference: closed-class English grammar

arms.C1: S92 rules (frozen baseline, as in the S93 check)
arms.R1: S93 frozen (provenance x nature, argument links)
arms.T1: R1 + table relations (relative difference, statistic rows, row subjects)
arms.T1-noarith: ablation: T1 without the relative-difference fit

development: SPENT material only: the S93 check (462 values; its first run is committed unchanged in evaluation/s93/check-firstrun.json) and the S93 development reference (S89+S91, 293 values). At most three reformulations, then freeze
independentCheck: after the freeze, on a new wave (never-examined pages, at least one never-taught category), with a blind reference sealed by hash before any arm runs; reported as first run unchanged (Stage 4 of S94)
metrics: false calculations on reference measured/declared values
links reaching the reference evidence line, and lines per value
inputs found: an input or assumption text on a reference assumption line
row subject: reviewed vs other product, on reference values with subject reviewed_product or other_product (set counts as other product)
stopRule: if T1 does not raise calculated recall on the S93 laptops without lowering nature-correct overall, Stage 1 records a negative result and stops
